name: Runemaster: can equip thrown weapons and keep them across relog (#13503)
contract: Issue #13503: Runemasters (class 32) already learn Throw (2764) at creation, but had no Thrown proficiency
(spell 2567, skill 176) in CoA baseline/proficiency tables, and SkillRaceClassInfo 233 omitted class 32 so
_LoadSkills would drop skill 176 on relog and _LoadInventory would mail back an equipped thrown weapon.
Expected: a level 80 Runemaster knows Thrown (2567) and skill 176, equips Light Throwing Knife (28979) in
the ranged slot (17), keeps it equipped with no mail after relog, and regains 2567 on login if missing.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: the thrown weapon is equipped in the ranged slot
DISCRIMINATING: the thrown weapon stays equipped after relog
DISCRIMINATING: the thrown weapon was not mailed back
Thrown proficiency is restored on login
